scope: Private local database snapshot; read-only product source volume; no Coolify deployment or shared-host load test

logicalPayload.definition: UTF-8 canonical text plus unboxed JSONB scalar mirror strings; excludes TOAST compression, indexes, row overhead and filesystem size

physicalDatabase.note: UPDATE leaves obsolete tuple versions; payload reduction does not imply an immediate smaller database file

limitations: No existing exports in the local snapshot; Markdown equality and PDF regression verified separately with controlled fixtures.
Physical database files were not rewritten or shrunk.
Skipped legacy rows can occupy a batch; use explicit analysis-id for selected maintenance.
Resource limits and backup for the shared Coolify server remain undecided.
